title: Crispy Red Quinoa and Vegetable Patties
subtitle: with sweet potato, leek and pine nuts
description: Red quinoa is mixed with sauteed leek and sweet potato, tahini, dried apricots, pine nuts and parsley, then shaped into small patties and shallow-fried until crisp. Serve hot or cold, for example with a wine tahini dip.

steps.text: Fry the quinoa in 1 tbsp olive oil in a medium pot for about 1 minute, add plenty of room-temperature water and cook for about 15 minutes until a white ring appears in the centre of each grain. Drain and cool.

Meanwhile, heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a medium frying pan and fry the chopped white part of the leek and the garlic over medium heat for about 5 minutes, until the leek softens, stirring occasionally. Transfer to a bowl and cool.
Add 3 more tbsp olive oil to the pan and fry the diced sweet potato for about 4 minutes, shaking the pan, until lightly golden. Add to the same bowl and cool.
Mix the cooked quinoa with the vegetables, tahini, chopped apricots, pine nuts, parsley, eggs, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper until uniform. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or overnight.
Shape into ping-pong-ball-sized patties and press down slightly.

Heat about 1 cm of canola oil in a large pan. Fry the patties over medium heat for about 2 minutes on each side until browned, and drain on paper towel. They keep in the fridge for up to 3 days and taste good hot or cold.
